Question 5

Determine the differential equation satisfied by the orthogonal trajectories of the family of curves xy=C2, where C≠0 is a parameter.

a
dydx=yx
b
dydx=yx2
c
dydx=−xy
d
dydx=−yx
e
dydx=xy
